sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.
2.

Present petition has been filed seeking direction to respondents to ensure fair, impartial and
proper investigation of the Case Crime No.854 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 323, 328, 313, 376,
506 Ipc and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Fareedpur, District Bareilly.
3. Learned counsel has prayed for issuance of suitable direction for fair and impartial investigation.
4.  Learned A.G.A. submits that the police authorities are under obligation to do the investigation fairly, impartially and expeditiously.

He apprised to the Court that the investigation is going on and Sarla Devi vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92319656/
1 the same would be concluded at the earliest, in accordance with law.
5.

entities.text: Sarla Devi vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The present petition is disposed of directing that the investigation is to be concluded by the Investigating Officer under the supervision of Senior Superintendent of Police, Bareilly fairly,
impartially and expeditiously.
6. It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case and the Competent Authority/Investigating Officer to act strictly in accordance with law.

. 
(Prashant Kumar, J.) (Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, J.) Order Date :- 11.4.2025
